sources.title: jacobian-lens: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview jacobian-lens is a collection of pre-fitted Jacobian Lens models for neural network interpretability, maintained by neuronpedia. These models were trained using Anthropic's Jacobian Lens library, a tool designed to understand how neural networks process information by analyzing the relationship between inputs and outputs through Jacobian matrices.
